description.zh: 校验的域名。仅支持单域名校验。
description.en: The domain name to verify. Only one domain name can be verified at a time.

description.zh:
域名归属权验证方式，取值：

- dnsCheck：DNS解析验证。
- fileCheck：文件验证。
description.en:
The verification method. Valid values:

- dnsCheck: DNS record verification

- fileCheck: file verification

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live verify-live-domain-owner --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --region cn-hangzhou
